title: Standard
tagline: A simple entry point for non-crypto natives to engage with DeFi that is affordable for someone with $100 and no knowledge of crypto  can participate
description: We built a simple on ramp for college students to get into DeFi lending with a little bit of money and simple interface. It is supposed to be as simple as two clicks to get into DeFi, deposit your cash and we'll automatically select the coin that is earning the highest interest and deposit it for you
how_its_made: Interfacing Aave on Matic Polygon chain for easy on and off ramp to defi lending on L2 for college students. Uses Stripe to purchase the currency, we transfer our own USDC to users wallet created with Argents swift web3 library. Then connected to Matic chain and used Aave's v2 contract to lend the tokens we collected.
